sample: Fernhollow is made up, to show what Arnheim does. Its people, projects, websites, numbers and work are all invented.
about: A made-up studio with four small projects, here to show what Arnheim does.

quote.text: Build slowly, look closely, and leave every place a little kinder than you found it.

founder.name: Ellison
founder.title: made-up founder, named after the hero of Poe's story

rooms.label: Goals
rooms.about: What a project is working toward. A red flag is open, a gold one is reached.

rooms.label: Work
rooms.about: The project's tasks, a desk each. A desk glows amber when it needs you, and someone sits at it, lit warm, while it is being worked on.

rooms.label: Conversations
rooms.about: Chats where the work gets talked through or done. Someone sits in a seat while one is working. Walking, stand in the ring beside them to bring it up.

rooms.label: Code
rooms.about: Open pull requests as books, and copies of the code with unsaved changes as crates.

floors.label: Studio
floors.about: The studio itself: its plans, its notes and how it runs.

routines.label: Security scan
routines.ask: Look for secrets or unsafe code added this week, and fix what you safely can.

extraRooms.label: Company
extraRooms.about: Money, legal, subscriptions and key dates, as the studio's own notes. A filing cabinet for each.

floors.label: Lantern
floors.about: A reading app that remembers where you stopped, on every device.

floors.label: Tidepool
floors.about: A weather station you build yourself, and the app that reads it.

floors.label: Kitefield
floors.about: A tool for designing kites and testing them before they meet the wind.

lobby.label: Front of house
lobby.about: Websites, email, social media and domains. Nothing here signs in, reads an inbox or posts.

rooms.label: Websites
rooms.about: The studio's websites, on a wall of screens. Iris, the receptionist, sits at the desk here.

rooms.label: Email
rooms.about: The studio's email addresses, as pigeonholes. Nothing here reads an inbox.

rooms.label: Social media
rooms.about: The studio's social media accounts, a signboard each.

rooms.label: Domains
rooms.about: The studio's domain names, as brass plaques.

basement.label: Shared machines
basement.about: The machines every project shares, and the Library of third-party code.

rooms.label: Build server
rooms.about: Builds every project's apps, mostly at night.

rooms.label: Library
rooms.about: Third-party code the studio uses or has looked at. It's a shelf: nothing here installs or runs it.

rooms.label: Test bench
rooms.about: Runs the long tests, and flies Kitefield's kites in a simulator.

rooms.label: Spare laptop
rooms.about: An old laptop kept for checking things on a small screen.
